[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/08/29 (Tue) 22:48  
[USER] User is interested in negotiating benefits or perks along with their salary.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Research: Before negotiating, research the company's benefits and perks policy to get an idea of what they offer.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Prioritize: Make a list of the perks or benefits you would like to have and prioritize them in order of importance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Justify your request: Explain why you think you deserve the additional benefits or perks. Highlight your skills, experience, and achievements as well as how they can contribute to the company's success.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Be flexible: Be open to negotiating and compromise. If the company cannot provide you with the benefits or perks you want, try to find common ground and reach an agreement that works for both parties.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Be prepared to wait: Sometimes, the company might need time to think over your request. It would help if you were patient and follow up with them respectfully.  
[USER] User asked for examples of perks or benefits to negotiate for other than salary.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Examples of perks or benefits to negotiate for include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Flexible work hours or remote work options  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Additional vacation time or paid time off  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Health insurance or other insurance benefits  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Retirement saving plans such as 401k or pension plans  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Professional development opportunities, such as training or tuition reimbursement  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Stock options or equity  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Company-provided phone, laptop or other technology equipment  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Gym membership or wellness programs  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Paid parental leave or childcare assistance  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Bonus or commission structure  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 11. Employee discounts or travel perks.
